breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not acknowledge that the 20% differential-to-static pressure ratio implies a high Mach number requiring compressible flow analysis. It retains the incompressible Bernoulli relation and does not compute or mention the Mach number, unlike the ground truth which explicitly calls for compressible isentropic relations.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the incompressible Bernoulli relation for the calculation,' directly repeating the original flawed instruction. The ground truth requires compressible isentropic relations (gamma=1.4, R=287 J/kg·K) to avoid the underestimation error inherent in the incompressible approach at higher Mach numbers.
